Refer to Appendix A for details. This is in keeping with other shopfronts in the area and constitutes a cosmetic, fully reversible change.The lighting level will be as detailed in the provisions of the ILP Guidance at a max level of E3 600 cd/m2  for externally illuminated advertisements in particular:a) Luminaires will be positioned such that the light source itself is not directly visible from any usual viewing angle (e.g. to road users or residents).b) Luminaires will be adequately secured and positioned such that they light away from adjacent properties or highways. Diffusers, shields or louvres should be incorporated where necessary to control spill light.c) Illumination will be switched off when not required, e.g. during the day and after agreed curfews.d) There will be no direct light
